name: nuclear-hexagram-computer-failure
description: Failure case: signals array length 2 (not 6) → computeHoQue throws Error. haos array length 2 (not 6) → computeBienQue throws Error. Tests input validation guard — both functions must throw descriptive errors on invalid input length.

expected.error_bienQue: computeBienQue requires exactly 6 HaoReading objects, got 2

notes: Both computeHoQue([1,0]) and computeBienQue([hao1, hao2]) must throw Errors. The sandbox catches the thrown error and records PASS (expected error path). Validates that the primitives fail loudly on malformed input rather than silently producing wrong results.
